subject: Telemetry evidence catalog + SIEM onramp questions
messages:
From: Devon Park <devon@cleardata.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-01T15:22:00Z
Subject: Getting telemetry evidence for SIEM onramp

Hi Jordan,

Hope you're well. We're starting the SIEM onramp for ClearHealth and the onboarding team asked for a compact evidence catalog that maps Redwood's private deployment telemetry outputs to the artifacts our SOC requires (logs, traces, retention policies, service identity, attestations). Specifically: 

- A short index of what logs are emitted from the VPC forwarder and their Splunk event types
- Sample trace headers/span tags that our tracing pipeline can key on for correlation
- Where to fetch audit trails (who changed forwarding rules, who rotated keys)
- Minimal attachments/pointers we can hand to our compliance team for review

Can you point me at an existing package or provide a short bundle we can review? We aim to complete the onramp by May 14.

Thanks,
Devon
ClearData Professional Services

Attachment: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Devon Park <devon@cleardata.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Getting telemetry evidence for SIEM onramp

Hi Devon — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Hannah (obs lead) and Ben (on-prem integrator) to assemble a compact evidence bundle. Quick notes so we align: 

- We maintain a lightweight CSV index for VPC/private deployments that maps forwarder topics -> Splunk sourcetypes; I'll attach a trimmed export.
- For traces, our guidance attaches the trace-id and span.role tags; Ben can add example span headers and an envoy filter snippet.
- Audit trails: in private we provide a time-limited export of control-plane audit logs (RBAC changes, forwarder config updates) plus KMS key rotation proofs.

Hannah/Ben: can you prepare: (1) CSV index, (2) small trace header examples, (3) package of config snippets + a zip with redacted audit examples? Target 48 hours.

Jordan
Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vpc_evidence_index_v1.csv

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Devon Park <devon@cleardata.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Getting telemetry evidence for SIEM onramp

Thanks — Ben and I put together a focused set. Summary below and attached snippets: 

1) Log taxonomy & Splunk mapping (attached CSV)
   - forwarder.syslog -> sourcetype:redwood:forwarder
   - runtime.infer -> sourcetype:redwood:inference
   - runtime.errors -> sourcetype:redwood:errors
   Notes: field extraction keys we recommend: request_id, model_id, seq_len, tenant_id (if present).

2) Trace correlation
   - We emit trace-id in X-Redwood-Trace header and span.role tags: front_proxy, runtime, kv_cache.
   - Example span header:
     Traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
     X-Redwood-Trace: 4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736

3) Audit evidence
   - Redacted control-plane audit export (format: JSON lines) included in the evidence bundle. Contains RBAC change events and forwarder config diffs.

4) Forwarder config snippet (attached) with TLS peering and HEC token masking.

Next steps: Jordan/Ben to produce the evidence ZIP and a one-page handoff that ClearHealth's compliance team can sign off on. Devon: is there a preferred filename format for the zip? We normally use evidence_bundle_<customer>_<date>.zip.

-Hannah
Obs & Security — Redwood Inference

Attachments: forwarder_config_snippet.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Devon Park <devon@cleardata.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Getting telemetry evidence for SIEM onramp

Devon — attaching the evidence bundle for your SOC intake and a short README with where each artifact came from. Highlights: 

- evidence_bundle_clearhealth_20270504.zip (contains):
  * redwood_vpc_evidence_index_v1.csv (mapping table)
  * audit_examples_redacted.jsonl (control-plane audit lines)
  * tracing_samples.txt (example headers and span roles)
  * forwarder_config_snippet.txt (TLS/HEC settings)

- README notes: retention defaults (30 days for forwarding sandbox; enterprise packages configurable), pointer to the private control-plane export procedure, and an S3 presigned link pattern we use for time-limited evidence pulls.

Action items for ClearHealth: confirm receipt and whether you need any additional attestations (KMS rotation certificates, SOC2 report excerpt). If you want, we can schedule a 30-min review with the ClearHealth SOC next week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_bundle_clearhealth_20270504.zip, README_evidence_bundle.txt
